meta.title: Session Delete
meta.description: Permanently deletes sessions and can optionally remove attachment blobs no longer referenced by any session. Includes a dry-run orphan scan command. Cannot be undone.

autoDeleteAttachments.title: Delete unreferenced attachments with sessions
autoDeleteAttachments.description: Default on. After session deletion, remove only blobs that no remaining disk, archived, or in-memory session references.

commands.scanAttachments: Scan orphan attachments (dry-run by default); append --confirm to delete.
